cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

cards.title: You First

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then carry my train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: A
